name: Presynaptic excitability and GABAergic inhibitory synapse assembly
rationale: Members combine presynaptic Ca2+/K+ channel control of release with GABA receptor/gephyrin clustering and inhibitory synapse assembly, which all confusables lack (they carry glutamatergic AMPA/kainate and secretion terms instead).

name: Peroxisomal matrix and membrane protein import
rationale: All members concern targeting and import of proteins into the peroxisome matrix and membrane (peroxisome biogenesis), whereas confusables are peroxisomal fatty acid metabolism with no shared members.

qualifier: ALK-STAT3 induction in tumor immune evasion
name: PD-L1 expression and turnover in tumor immune evasion
rationale: Members cover PD-L1 transcription (including ALK-STAT3 nuclear events), glycosylation and degradation and T-cell responses to tumor, distinguishing it from neddylation, Nef and liver confusables.

name: GLUT4 translocation and adipocyte glucose uptake
rationale: Members describe GLUT4 trafficking to the plasma membrane, glucose import, RHOQ cycling and adiponectin secretion, unlike confusables centred on insulin receptor signalling or exocyst tethering.

qualifier: stress granule and PKR stress response
name: AU-rich element mRNA turnover and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members combine ARE-binding protein control of mRNA stability and translational silencing with stress granule assembly/disassembly, PKR and arsenite responses, which mRNA-decay confusables lack.

name: Deoxyribonucleotide metabolism and ADA/PNP purine salvage defects
rationale: Members are deoxyribonucleoside/deoxynucleotide synthesis and catabolism with ADA and PNP deficiency, separating it from ribonucleotide purine catabolism and general pyrimidine metabolism confusables.

qualifier: TRKA and TRKC to MAPK, ERK5 and p38 cascades
name: TRKA and TRKC neurotrophin signalling to MAPK cascades
rationale: Members are NGF-TRKA and NT-3-NTRK3 signalling through RAS/MAPK, ERK5, p38, PI3K and PLCG1, distinct from p75NTR death signalling and BDNF-TRKB confusables.

qualifier: PDGF receptor regulation in mechanoresponsive fibroblasts
name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signalling and PDGF receptor regulation
rationale: Members combine Hippo/YAP-TAZ transcription and cell-density sensing with PDGFR-alpha/beta and FGFR signalling control in fibroblasts; confusables lack either the Hippo arm or the PDGF arm.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and receptor-proximal signalling
name: Wnt ligand secretion and receptor-proximal Wnt/Ca2+ signalling
rationale: Members cover Wnt biogenesis, PORCN and Golgi secretion, ligand antagonists, LRP5/DVL activation and the non-canonical calcium pathway, unlike destruction-complex, Hedgehog or vascular Wnt confusables.

name: Gluconeogenesis from fructose, glycerol and alanine
rationale: Members are fructose, glycerol/alditol, alanine and oxaloacetate metabolism feeding gluconeogenesis, distinct from glucose-6-phosphate, pentose, galactose and glycolysis confusables.

qualifier: CRH-driven ACTH and glucocorticoid secretion in stress
name: Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis activation in stress
rationale: Members trace CRH response, corticotropin and cortisol secretion, fear and general adaptation, unlike confusables centred on stress behaviours or downstream glucocorticoid signalling.

name: Renal epithelial polarity, junctions and brush border
rationale: Members cover apical-basal polarity, tight junctions, microvillus/brush border assembly and podocyte/nephrin glomerular epithelium, separating it from glomerular vasculature, apical sorting and adherens confusables.

name: DNA replication stress and topoisomerase lesion repair
rationale: Members concern replication fork stress (hydroxyurea, fork reversal, R-loops, replication initiation) and topoisomerase-related DNA topology and protein-DNA crosslink repair, unlike telomere and checkpoint confusables.

qualifier: dendritic cell IL-12 and antigen presentation against protozoa
name: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 immunity to protozoa
rationale: Members link IL-12, IFN-gamma and Th1 cytokine production to activated dendritic cells and protozoan defence; DC antigen presentation and protozoan response are what the Th1/NKT confusables lack.

name: Calcium-stimulated adenylate cyclase signalling to CREB
rationale: All three members describe adenylate cyclase-generated cAMP driving CREB activation, with Ca2+/calmodulin-stimulated ADCY1/8, unlike PKA, CaMK-CREB and synaptic plasticity confusables.

qualifier: myofibroblast differentiation and connective tissue replacement
name: Fibrotic connective tissue replacement and myofibroblast control
rationale: Members regulate fibrosis via fibroblast/myofibroblast differentiation, collagen and ECM assembly and connective tissue replacement, unlike confusables on fibroblast survival/migration or collagen biosynthesis.

qualifier: isoform-specific ligand binding and FRS/SHC cascades
name: FGFR isoform ligand binding and FRS/SHC-mediated signalling
rationale: Members are FGFR1-4 splice-isoform ligand binding, Klotho, oncogenic mutants and FRS/SHC/PLCG cascades, unlike Sprouty-regulation or PI3K-cascade FGFR confusables and EGFR/MET signalling.

name: Classical RHO and CDC42-subfamily GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are RHOA/B/C, CDC42, RHOJ and RHOG GTPase cycles and Gbeta-gamma-CDC42 signalling, separating it from atypical RHO/RND and RAC confusables.

qualifier: clathrin coat dynamics and postsynaptic receptor trafficking
name: Clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle recycling and receptor trafficking
rationale: Members cover clathrin coat assembly/disassembly, synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling, and neurotransmitter receptor internalization, unlike confusables on vesicle docking, release cycles or Rab/ARF signalling.

name: Intestinal and renal hexose, urate and amino acid transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated epithelial transport of sugars, urate and amino acids with their transporter diseases and carbohydrate digestion; hexose/urate terms distinguish it from amino acid transporter confusables.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor and chemokine production
name: Formyl peptide and chemokine-driven myeloid leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members regulate neutrophil, macrophage and granulocyte chemotaxis via formyl peptide receptors and chemokine production, unlike degranulation, respiratory burst, extravasation or DC cytokine confusables.

name: Lipid droplet biogenesis, turnover and adipocyte triglyceride storage
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet formation, fusion and lipophagy, triglyceride storage and adipogenesis, unlike LXR lipogenesis, fatty acid oxidation or triglyceride synthesis confusables.

name: NGF-TRKA and NT-3-TRKC receptor-proximal signalling
rationale: Members are TRKA activation by NGF and NTRK3 activation by NT-3 with proximal PLCG1, PI3K, RAS and STAT3 outputs; confusables lack either the TRKA or the TRKC arm.

name: Cerebellar motor coordination, proprioception and locomotion
rationale: Six of seven members concern locomotion, righting, proprioception and Purkinje layer formation (a neuronal RNA-binding module is a loose fit); proprioception distinguishes it from cerebellar-development and behaviour confusables.

name: ADP P2Y and GPVI-driven platelet activation
rationale: Members are platelet activation via ADP P2Y1/P2Y12 receptors, GPVI and LDL sensitization, unlike thrombin/thromboxane GPCR or adhesion/aggregation confusables.
